set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 5. Add namespaced major-versioned representation keys, a narrow archive-neutral representation envelope, an immutable duplicate-rejecting registry, unsupported-representation errors, and a named LegacyLnaRepresentationFamily delegating to current behavior. Acceptance: registry construction is deterministic and order-independent; tests can install one family; a manifest can select only already installed code; unknown representation and corrupt archive remain distinct; legacy LNA fixtures still open.
set.title: RRA 5: add representation keys, narrow envelopes, and explicit registry
